raw:
{
  "cases": [
    {
      "question": "请统计各城市在最近一段时间的销售数量与销售金额，按销售金额降序排列，返回城市、销售数量、销售金额三列，最多100行。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "统计各城市维度下 valid orders 对应的 order_items.quantity 总和（销售数量）与 order_items.item_amount 总和（销售金额），时间范围需明确为最近一段时间，此处指参考日期2026-09-12前推30天的完整日历区间。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-08-13 至 2026-09-12",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "问题中‘最近一段时间’未指定具体天数或日历边界，存在多种合理业务解读：既可理解为滚动30天（最常用），也可理解为上一自然月（2026年8月1日至31日）；二者覆盖订单量、退款重叠率、新客渗透等指标差异显著，属实质性业务歧义。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["2026-08-01 至 2026-08-31", "2026-08-13 至 2026-09-12"],
      "semantic_signature": "cities:sum_quantity_sum_item_amount:rolling_30d_vs_last_month",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.city, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity, ROUND(SUM(oi.item_amount), 2) AS sales_amount FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-13' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请列出各品牌在最近一个周期内面向不同客户层级的销售贡献，返回品牌、用户等级、销售数量、销售金额四列，最多100行。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按品牌与用户等级（users.user_level）两维交叉聚合，计算 valid orders 下 order_items.quantity 总和与 item_amount 总和；‘最近一个周期’指参考日期2026-09-12起向前推7天的完整日历区间。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-09-06 至 2026-09-12",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘最近一个周期’未明确定义周期长度及对齐方式：可解释为最近7天滚动区间（业务常用监控粒度），亦可解释为最近完整周（2026-09-05 至 2026-09-11，周日到周六）；二者影响周末效应捕捉、VIP复购归因等分析结论。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["2026-09-05 至 2026-09-11", "2026-09-06 至 2026-09-12"],
      "semantic_signature": "brands_user_levels:sum_quantity_sum_item_amount:rolling_7d_vs_week_sun_sat",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.brand, u.user_level, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity, ROUND(SUM(oi.item_amount), 2) AS sales_amount FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-06' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY p.brand, u.user_level ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请输出各省份在最近阶段的付费用户数与对应总销售额，返回省份、付费用户数、总销售额三列，最多100行。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按省份（users.province）分组，统计 distinct user_id 数量（付费用户数）及 SUM(orders.paid_amount)（总销售额），时间范围为参考日期2026-09-12前推90天的滚动区间。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-06-14 至 2026-09-12",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘最近阶段’缺乏标准定义：常见业务口径包括滚动90天（季度复盘）、上一季度（2026年第二季度：2026-04-01 至 2026-06-30）、或最近完整自然季（2026年第三季度截至9月12日，即2026-07-01 至 2026-09-12）；三者覆盖新老客结构、促销节奏、季节性波动差异大。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["2026-04-01 至 2026-06-30", "2026-06-14 至 2026-09-12"],
      "semantic_signature": "provinces:count_distinct_user_id_sum_paid_amount:q2_vs_rolling_90d",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.province, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS paying_users, ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount), 2) AS total_sales FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-06-14' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY u.province ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请给出各城市在近期的订单数与销售金额对比，返回城市、订单数、销售金额三列，最多100行。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按城市分组，统计 valid orders 的订单总数（COUNT(*)）及 SUM(order_items.item_amount)（销售金额）；‘近期’指参考日期2026-09-12前推14天的滚动区间。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-08-30 至 2026-09-12",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘近期’无统一业务定义：可理解为滚动14天（用于快速响应运营动作），亦可理解为最近两个自然周（2026-08-25 至 2026-09-07），后者便于周同比；二者对节庆营销、物流延迟导致的订单滞后入账敏感度不同。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["2026-08-25 至 2026-09-07", "2026-08-30 至 2026-09-12"],
      "semantic_signature": "cities:count_orders_sum_item_amount:rolling_14d_vs_two_weeks",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.city, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(oi.item_amount), 2) AS sales_amount FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-30' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请展示各品牌在当前周期的销售数量与平均客单价，返回品牌、销售数量、平均客单价三列，最多100行。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按品牌分组，统计 order_items.quantity 总和（销售数量）及 SUM(orders.paid_amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id)（平均客单价）；‘当前周期’指2026年9月1日至2026年9月12日。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-09-01 至 2026-09-12",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘当前周期’可能被理解为‘本月至今’（2026-09-01 至 2026-09-12，最符合常规财务/运营日报），也可能被理解为‘本自然周’（2026-09-07 至 2026-09-12，周一至周日制）；前者反映月度目标进度，后者侧重周度动销效率。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["2026-09-01 至 2026-09-12", "2026-09-07 至 2026-09-12"],
      "semantic_signature": "brands:sum_quantity_avg_order_value:month_to_date_vs_week_to_date",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity, ROUND(AVG(o.paid_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请汇总各客户等级在最近窗口期的销售金额与退款金额，返回用户等级、销售金额、退款金额三列，最多100行。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按用户等级（users.user_level）分组，统计 valid orders 的 SUM(orders.paid_amount)（销售金额）与 refunds 表中 refund_status='approved' 的 SUM(refunds.refund_amount)（退款金额）；‘最近窗口期’指2026-09-01至2026-09-12。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-09-01 至 2026-09-12",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘最近窗口期’存在两种主流业务解释：一是自然月窗口（9月1日至12日，匹配财务结算节奏），二是滚动窗口（如过去12天：2026-08-31 至 2026-09-12），后者更利于观察退款延迟（如7天无理由）的时效分布。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["2026-09-01 至 2026-09-12", "2026-08-31 至 2026-09-12"],
      "semantic_signature": "user_levels:sum_paid_amount_sum_refund_amount:sep1to12_vs_rolling_12d",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.user_level, ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount), 2) AS sales_amount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0), 2) AS refund_amount FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY u.user_level ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请提供各城市在近段时间的销售数量与销售金额占比，返回城市、销售数量、销售金额占比三列，最多100行。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按城市分组，统计 order_items.quantity 总和（销售数量）及该城市 sales_amount 占全部城市总 sales_amount 的百分比（保留4位小数）；‘近段时间’指2026-08-01至2026-08-31。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-08-01 至 2026-08-31",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘近段时间’在跨月场景下易生歧义：可指上一自然月（2026年8月），便于月度环比；亦可指滚动30天（2026-08-13至2026-09-12），更反映实时趋势。二者对月末冲量、月初淡季的权重分配完全不同。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["2026-08-01 至 2026-08-31", "2026-08-13 至 2026-09-12"],
      "semantic_signature": "cities:sum_quantity_sales_amount_rate:aug_vs_rolling_30d",
      "reference_sql": "WITH city_sales AS (SELECT u.city, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS city_sales_amount FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY u.city), total AS (SELECT SUM(city_sales_amount) AS grand_total FROM city_sales) SELECT cs.city, cs.sales_quantity, ROUND(cs.city_sales_amount / t.grand_total, 4) AS sales_amount_rate FROM city_sales cs CROSS JOIN total t ORDER BY sales_amount_rate DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请列出各品类在最近区间的销售数量与销售金额，返回品类、销售数量、销售金额三列，最多100行。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按产品品类（products.category）分组，统计 order_items.quantity 总和与 item_amount 总和；‘最近区间’指2026-09-01至2026-09-12。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-09-01 至 2026-09-12",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘最近区间’未限定起止：可理解为‘本月迄今’（2026-09-01至12日），适配月度目标追踪；亦可理解为‘最近7个工作日’（2026-09-01至2026-09-09，排除9月10日中秋假期），更准确反映有效营业日产能。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["2026-09-01 至 2026-09-12", "2026-09-01 至 2026-09-09"],
      "semantic_signature": "categories:sum_quantity_sum_item_amount:sep1to12_vs_workdays",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity, ROUND(SUM(oi.item_amount), 2) AS sales_amount FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请统计各品牌在近期的销售数量与退款率，返回品牌、销售数量、退款率四列，最多100行。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "hard",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按品牌分组，统计 order_items.quantity 总和（销售数量）及 approved refund amount / product sales amount（退款率，保留4位小数）；‘近期’指2026-08-15至2026-09-12。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-08-15 至 2026-09-12",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘近期’对退款率计算影响关键：若取滚动30天（2026-08-14至2026-09-12），则包含大量尚未完成退款审核的订单，导致分母偏大、率值偏低；若取上月加本月迄今（2026-08-01至2026-09-12），则更匹配财务口径，但拉长周期稀释时效性。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["2026-08-01 至 2026-09-12", "2026-08-14 至 2026-09-12"],
      "semantic_signature": "brands:sum_quantity_refund_rate:aug1tosep12_vs_rolling_30d",
      "reference_sql": "WITH brand_sales AS (SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS brand_sales_amount FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-15' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY p.brand), brand_refunds AS (SELECT p.brand, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS brand_refund_amount FROM products p JOIN refunds r ON p.product_id = r.product_id JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-15' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY p.brand) SELECT bs.brand, bs.sales_quantity, ROUND(COALESCE(br.brand_refund_amount / bs.brand_sales_amount, 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM brand_sales bs LEFT JOIN brand_refunds br ON bs.brand = br.brand ORDER BY refund_rate DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请输出各客户等级在最近时段的销售金额与平均单笔退款金额，返回用户等级、销售金额、平均单笔退款金额三列，最多100行。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "按用户等级分组，统计 SUM(orders.paid_amount)（销售金额）及 AVG(refunds.refund_amount)（平均单笔退款金额，仅 approved）；‘最近时段’指2026-09-05至2026-09-12。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026-09-05 至 2026-09-12",
      "answer_slot": "time",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘最近时段’在退款分析中具双重含义：可指订单发生时段（2026-09-05至12日），用于归因消费行为；亦可指退款发生时段（refund_date 同区间），用于评估客服处理效率。二者数据源不同，结果不可比。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["2026-09-05 至 2026-09-12 (order_date)", "2026-09-05 至 2026-09-12 (refund_date)"],
      "semantic_signature": "user_levels:sum_paid_amount_avg_refund_amount:by_order_date_vs_refund_date",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.user_level, ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount), 2) AS sales_amount, ROUND(AVG(r.refund_amount), 2) AS avg_refund_amount FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-05' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY u.user_level ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    }
  ]
}
